name: Token
doc: A token stream element: a payload, or a segment separator.
stmt:
inductive Token (R : Type) where
                       
  | sym : R → Token R
                            
  | sep : Token R
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: Encoded
doc:
An encoded linear form: its arity, then its tokens.

The arity is **first-class** rather than implicit in the length of a coefficient list.
Without it, a decoder cannot rebuild a `LinearForm R n` at a statically known `n`, which
is exactly why the legacy representation could only ever work with `List R`.
stmt:
structure Encoded (R : Type) where
                                 
  arity : Nat
                                                                            
  toks : List (Token R)

namespace Encoded

variable {R : Type}

name: payload
doc: The coefficient payload of an `Encoded`, in order.
stmt: def payload (e : Encoded R) : List R
proof:
e.toks.filterMap fun t => match t with
    | .sym r => some r
    | .sep => none

name: separators
doc: Count of separators. A well-formed encoding has exactly one.
stmt: def separators (e : Encoded R) : Nat
proof:
e.toks.countP (fun t => match t with | .sep => true | .sym _ => false)

end Encoded

                                

section Encode

variable {R : Type}

name: encodeForm
doc:
Encode a linear form: the arity, then every coefficient, then the constant, then a
separator.

`LinearForm R n` supplies the coefficients through `Fin n`, so the stream length is
determined by the type rather than by whatever list happens to be passed.
stmt: def encodeForm [DecidableEq R] (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) : Encoded R
proof:
{ arity := n
    toks := (List.finRange n |>.map fun i => Token.sym (c.a i)) ++ [Token.sym c.b, Token.sep] }

name: encodeForm_length
doc:
The number of tokens produced by encoding an arity-`n` form: `n` coefficients, one
constant, one separator.
stmt:
theorem encodeForm_length [DecidableEq R] (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) :
    (encodeForm c).toks.length = n + 2
proof:
by
  unfold encodeForm
  simp [List.length_append, List.length_map, List.length_finRange]

name: encodeForm_arity
doc: The arity field of an encoding is the form's arity.
stmt:
@[simp] theorem encodeForm_arity [DecidableEq R] (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) :
    (encodeForm c).arity = n
proof:
rfl

end Encode

                                      

section Decode

variable {R : Type} [DecidableEq R]

name: decodeCoeffs
doc:
The coefficient list of a payload, taking the first `n` entries.

Kept as a plain `def` so downstream statements mention a concrete list rather than an
inline `take`.
stmt: def decodeCoeffs (n : Nat) (rs : List R) : List R
proof: rs.take n

name: decodeConst
doc:
The constant term of a payload, when one is present.

Returns `none` when the payload is too short. The decoder refuses rather than inventing a
constant, which is the honest boundary the legacy `decode_drops_trailing_partial` records.
stmt: def decodeConst (n : Nat) (rs : List R) : Option R
proof: rs[n]?

name: decodePayload
doc:
Decode a payload back into a linear form at the arity the stream declares.

`none` when the constant term is missing, i.e. when the payload has at most `n` entries.
The coefficients are padded with `take`, so a payload that is too *long* is accepted with
its tail dropped -- but the arity prefix means the drop is visible in the encoding length,
which the legacy list-based scheme could not express.
stmt: def decodePayload (n : Nat) (rs : List R) [Inhabited R] : Option (Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n)
proof:
match decodeConst n rs with
  | none => none
  | some b =>
    some
      { a := fun i => (decodeCoeffs n rs).getD i.val
                        (default : R)
        b := b }

end Decode

                                                                   

section Necessity

name: arity_is_load_bearing
doc:
**Arity is not redundant.** Two forms of *different* arity have different encodings
only because the arity is carried; if it were dropped, a decoder could not recover it.

This witness does not exist in the legacy tree, because the legacy encoding had no arity
field to drop -- the number of variables was the length of a coefficient list. That is the
same decision that made the truncated `dot` invisible.
stmt:
theorem arity_is_load_bearing :
    (encodeForm (⟨fun _ => (1 : ℤ), 0⟩ : Lattice.Core.LinearForm ℤ 1)).arity ≠
    (encodeForm (⟨fun _ => (1 : ℤ), 0⟩ : Lattice.Core.LinearForm ℤ 2)).arity
proof:
by
  decide

name: constant_carried
doc:
**The constant term is not redundant (round-trip form).** Two forms differing only in
`b` would encode identically if `b` were omitted, so the round-trip would fail.
stmt:
theorem constant_carried :
    (encodeForm (⟨fun _ => (0 : ℤ), 0⟩ : Lattice.Core.LinearForm ℤ 1)).toks ≠
    (encodeForm (⟨fun _ => (0 : ℤ), 1⟩ : Lattice.Core.LinearForm ℤ 1)).toks
proof:
by
  decide

name: constant_changes_semantics
doc:
**The constant term is not redundant (semantic form).** Omitting `b` is not a harmless
simplification: the two forms below accept different points, so conflating them would
produce the wrong constraint object.
stmt:
theorem constant_changes_semantics :
    ¬ Lattice.Core.SatisfiesEq (⟨fun _ => (0 : ℤ), 1⟩ : Lattice.Core.LinearForm ℤ 1) (fun _ => 0)
proof:
by
  unfold Lattice.Core.SatisfiesEq Lattice.Core.LinearForm.denote
  simp

name: separator_count_distinguishes
doc:
**The separator is not redundant.** Without a segment boundary, one form with two
coefficients and two forms with one coefficient each would produce the same payload, so a
decoder could not recover the segmentation. Here the separator count distinguishes them.
stmt:
theorem separator_count_distinguishes :
    (encodeForm (⟨fun _ => (0 : ℤ), 0⟩ : Lattice.Core.LinearForm ℤ 2)).separators = 1 ∧
    (encodeForm (⟨fun _ => (0 : ℤ), 0⟩ : Lattice.Core.LinearForm ℤ 2)).toks.length = 4
proof:
by
  decide

end Necessity

name: splitOn
doc: Split a token list on separators, dropping separators.
stmt: def splitOn (ts : List (Token R)) : List (List R)
proof:
ts.foldr
    (fun t acc => match t with
      | .sep => [] :: acc
      | .sym r => match acc with
        | [] => [[r]]
        | seg :: rest => (r :: seg) :: rest)
    []


end Lattice.Lift

name: filterMap_sym_append
doc: **`filterMap` 穿透一串 `sym`。**
stmt:
theorem filterMap_sym_append (l : List R) (tail : List (Token R)) :
    List.filterMap (fun t => match t with | .sym r => some r | .sep => none)
        (l.map Token.sym ++ tail)
      = l ++ List.filterMap (fun t => match t with | .sym r => some r | .sep => none) tail
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons_append, List.filterMap_cons]
    rw [ih]

name: filterMap_comp_append
doc:
**复合形式**：`map (fun i => sym (f i))` 的 `filterMap` 是 `map f`。

直接对复合形式归纳，不试图把它改写成 `map sym`——理由见文件头 §2(b)。
stmt:
theorem filterMap_comp_append {ι : Type} (l : List ι) (f : ι → R) (tail : List (Token R)) :
    List.filterMap (fun t => match t with | .sym r => some r | .sep => none)
        (l.map (fun i => Token.sym (f i)) ++ tail)
      = l.map f
        ++ List.filterMap (fun t => match t with | .sym r => some r | .sep => none) tail
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons_append, List.filterMap_cons]
    rw [ih]

name: encodeForm_payload
doc: **`encodeForm c` 的 payload 是「系数列表 ++ [常数项]」。**
stmt:
theorem encodeForm_payload (n : Nat) (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) :
    (encodeForm c).payload = (List.finRange n).map (fun i => c.a i) ++ [c.b]
proof:
by
  have hshape : (encodeForm c).toks
      = (List.finRange n).map (fun i => Token.sym (c.a i)) ++ [Token.sym c.b, Token.sep] := rfl
  show (Encoded.payload ⟨(encodeForm c).arity, (encodeForm c).toks⟩ : List R) = _
  rw [hshape]
  exact filterMap_comp_append (List.finRange n) (fun i => c.a i) [Token.sym c.b, Token.sep]

name: encodeForm_payload_length
doc: 该 payload 的长度是 `n + 1`。
stmt:
theorem encodeForm_payload_length (n : Nat) (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) :
    (encodeForm c).payload.length = n + 1
proof:
by
  rw [encodeForm_payload]
  simp [List.length_finRange]

name: finRange_getElem
doc: `finRange n` 的第 `i` 项（`i < n`）是 `⟨i, _⟩`。
stmt:
theorem finRange_getElem? {n : ℕ} {i : ℕ} (h : i < n) :
    (List.finRange n)[i]? = some (⟨i, h⟩ : Fin n)
proof:
by
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa using h)]
  rw [List.getElem_finRange]
  simp

name: payload_getElem
doc: 第 `i` 项（`i < n`）是 `c.a i`。
stmt:
theorem payload_getElem?_coeff (n : Nat) (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) (i : Fin n) :
    (encodeForm c).payload[i.val]? = some (c.a i)
proof:
by
  rw [encodeForm_payload]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by simp [List.length_finRange])]
  rw [List.getElem?_map]
  rw [finRange_getElem? i.isLt]
  rfl

name: payload_getElem
doc: 第 `n` 项是常数项 `c.b`。
stmt:
theorem payload_getElem?_const (n : Nat) (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) :
    (encodeForm c).payload[n]? = some c.b
proof:
by
  rw [encodeForm_payload]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by simp [List.length_finRange])]
  simp

name: decodeConst_encodeForm
doc: **`decodeConst` 在编码上返回 `some c.b`。**
stmt:
theorem decodeConst_encodeForm (n : Nat) (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) :
    decodeConst n (encodeForm c).payload = some c.b
proof: payload_getElem?_const n c

name: decodeCoeffs_encodeForm
doc: **`decodeCoeffs` 的每一项是 `c.a i`。**
stmt:
theorem decodeCoeffs_encodeForm (n : Nat) (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) (i : Fin n) :
    (decodeCoeffs n (encodeForm c).payload).getD i.val (default : R) = c.a i
proof:
by
  unfold decodeCoeffs
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  rw [List.getElem?_take_of_lt i.isLt]
  rw [payload_getElem?_coeff]
  rfl

name: decodePayload_encodeForm
doc:
**`encodeForm` 与 `decodePayload` 在单形式上互逆。**

`decodePayload n (encodeForm c).payload = some c`。

此前 `encodeForm` 与 `decodePayload` 是两个孤立的定义，
「token 能还原成符号」只有注释支持；这条定理使其成为命题。
stmt:
theorem decodePayload_encodeForm (n : Nat) (c : Lattice.Core.LinearForm R n) :
    decodePayload n (encodeForm c).payload = some c
proof:
by
  unfold decodePayload
  rw [decodeConst_encodeForm]
  simp only
  congr 1
  cases c with
  | mk a b =>
    simp only
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact decodeCoeffs_encodeForm n ⟨a, b⟩ i

end L1L2Roundtrip

end Lattice.Lift
